name: phase8_d_functional_form_v1

candidate_defs.min_sat: f(D) = min(1, D/k); k fit by held-out
candidate_defs.exp_sat: f(D) = 1 - exp(-D/k); k fit by held-out

protocol: leave-one-D-out; fit on all other D, predict held-out D

splits.interpolation: hold out each interior D (1..12), train on the rest
splits.extrapolation: hold out D=16 (largest), train on D<=12

preregistered_questions: Q1 which f(D) minimises held-out MAE (interpolation)?
Q2 which f(D) survives extrapolation to D=16?
Q3 does any candidate beat the frozen 7-feature law on held-out D?
Q4 how many monotonicity violations does each candidate make?
